title: NFIP paid building claims by county, 2015-2024

source.filter: yearOfLoss eq <year> and amountPaidOnBuildingClaim gt 0 (one request per year)
source.fema_notice: This product uses the Federal Emergency Management Agency’s OpenFEMA API, but is not endorsed by FEMA. The Federal Government or FEMA cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from the Agency's website(s).
source.fema_dataset_statement: This dataset is not intended to be an official federal report, and should not be considered an official federal report.

county_names_source.file: 2020 FIPS codes for counties and county equivalents

method.amount_basis: amounts paid by NFIP on building claims, not repair cost; nominal dollars
method.fema_county_caveat: FEMA: the County Code field may not reflect the individual county the property is located
method.recent_window_rule: 2020-2024 columns are empty when that window has fewer than 100 paid claims
method.top_event: named floodEvent with the most paid claims in the county and window (empty if none); ties (same count) broken by event name, ascending code-point order; share = its paid claims / n_paid
method.rounding: ROUND_HALF_UP; dollars to the dollar, shares to 3 decimals
